_schema.description: 端到端测试只允许替换 transport；不得 mock producer main、RPC 业务函数、scan 业务函数、receipt builder、runner、aggregator 或 validator。

required_entry_fields.production_callsite: 仓库相对路径加函数或行级 callsite
required_entry_fields.protocol: 例如 EVM JSON-RPC、Solana JSON-RPC、SQD HTTP/NDJSON
required_entry_fields.fake_backend: fake backend 或 loopback server 的实现与地址
required_entry_fields.test_id: 唯一、稳定、可由 suite 直接运行的测试 ID
required_entry_fields.allowed_reason: 为什么该注入只替换 transport，且不绕过生产业务逻辑

entries.allowed_reason: Runs the production main and shared attested session; only HTTP transport is replaced, and the call log proves zero eth_* business requests on mismatch.
Runs the production producer and receipt logic; only HTTP transport is replaced, with zero eth_call requests on mismatch.
Runs plan parsing, production target binding and shared session; only transport is fake and no business request occurs on mismatch.
Runs the production totalSupply gate and receipt error path; only HTTP transport is replaced, with zero eth_call requests on mismatch.
Runs the production CLI before input consumption; only transport is fake and no Multicall eth_call occurs on mismatch.
Runs the production CLI and shared session; only transport is fake and no depositBalances eth_call occurs on mismatch.
Runs the production CLI before parquet access; only transport is fake and no receipt business request occurs on mismatch.
Runs the production collector entry before output creation; only transport is fake and no eth_getLogs occurs on mismatch.
Runs the production CLI and raw/getCode dispatcher; only transport is fake and no selected business method occurs on mismatch.
Runs the formal-channel producer before output creation; only transport is fake and no alchemy_getAssetTransfers occurs on mismatch.

Production CLIs, RpcPool attestation, receipt builders and controlled runner are unchanged. The B3 wrong-chain loopback executes production time_spotcheck and records eth_chainId only; per-callsite zero-business coverage is supplied separately by Batch 1 test_each_formal_callsite_wrong_chain_zero_business.
The real accounting producer builds and parses the HyperSync query; loopback replaces only the remote transport response.
The production permission adapter handles an unverified contract through its documented 404 branch; no permission business function is mocked.

Real producer/consumer mains, attestation, observation window, activity parser, three-way closure and receipt publication execute unchanged; only the HTTP endpoint is loopback. supply_truth consumes the resulting bundle and has no Solana transport of its own.

entries.fake_backend: scripts/tests/test_batch3_solana_vertical_slice.py loopback Solana stream handler selected by --endpoint
entries.allowed_reason: The real anchor/window scan, timestamp validation, joint transaction and receipt logic execute unchanged; only the remote SQD response is supplied locally.
The fake returns decoded RPC transport responses only. Production attestation, minContextSlot, monotonic slot, activity mode, writable parsing, supply closure and retry logic all execute unchanged.
Both shells import and execute the production observation/activity library; the offline test replaces only request_json and verifies the carrier wiring without network access.

entries.protocol: Solana JSON-RPC state anchor for SQD dataset identity
entries.fake_backend: scripts/tests/test_r9_batch3_solana_observation.py SolanaTransportFake passed as request_json; Fetcher.head is replaced only in the wrong-cache pre-request branch
entries.allowed_reason: The production collector main/run and dataset adapter reject wrong dataset, empty or cache-mismatched mint, reversed range, wrong genesis and uncovered head. The fake replaces only state RPC, and the head stub is used only to reach cache identity validation before any SQD stream request.
